final_rationale: The verdict does not change. The Actor offered no new admissible evidence and expressly conceded the core predicates remain unresolved: the segment misses target, it is a named launch use case in customer commitments, legal disclosure review is still open, and there is no evidence of resolution, disclosure completion, or approved risk acceptance before launch. That narrower framing is a reinterpretation of the same record, not new evidence. The distinction the Actor draws between aggregate launch readiness and policy compliance is valid as a conceptual matter, but it does not cure the compliance failure on this record. Aggregate readiness and stable rehearsal support operational readiness in a limited sense, yet the governing policy makes materiality turn on the named-use-case/customer-commitment fact pattern and pending legal review, not on aggregate performance or monitoring plans. Because those initial concerns remain open after concern accounting, a move to compliant_with_caveats would be unsupported.
